text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just listen to those cheers. They're all
looking at
me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So this is what it's like to be the number
one racer
in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This is how things should be. I won't give
this spot
up—not to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. I'll get first place again and
again.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll win every race there is and prove that
I'm the
number one Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Time to continue my Tiara tour. Next up
is... the
Japanese Oaks!
